fail_closed_requirements: Resolve full immutable model revision before qualification.
Record model.safetensors SHA-256 and byte length.
Record tokenizer/config hashes and exact upstream evaluator source blob.
Refuse inference when expected trained weights are absent, mismatched, partial, or corrupt.
Refuse random initialization and any fallback checkpoint.
Do not load training_args.bin or other pickle-bearing artifacts in the benchmark path.
Emit no score when checkpoint identity or load status is unknown.
Keep raw model outputs, range validation, runtime identity, and input identity.
Keep model scores separate from human judgments.
unsupported_status_conditions: Full model or dataset revision cannot be pinned.
Data-use and consent review is incomplete.
Reference evaluator cannot prove exact trained weights were loaded.

required_evidence: Participant consent notice and applicable ethics-review evidence.
Permitted research, model-training, processing, and redistribution purposes.
Rights of the summary-judgment annotation records.
Whether the visible Hub artifact includes all four-axis judgments or only opinion text.

until_cleared: Do not download or mirror participant-level dataset files into Mycelix.
Do not publish participant comments or derived participant-level examples.
Do not train on participant data.

blockers: Visible Hub viewer exposes ten topic rows but does not establish availability of the paper-reported 4,500 summary-judgment annotations.
Dataset and model Hub revisions are only observed as short commit identifiers in the current public page rendering.
Dataset and model cards are metadata-only.
Participant data collection and consent provenance are not sufficiently documented in the inspected repository materials.
Upstream evaluator can silently fall back to random initialization.
next_steps: Resolve full Hub commit SHAs and exact file lists.
Locate complete judgment artifacts and split definitions.
Complete data-use and consent review before participant-level intake.
